text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'm pretty sure I'm pushin' it way
too far...
keeping my pulse up this long...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Pant... How's my time?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Pant... One more set...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Let's do this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur and I hit the pool for some
early
training this morning in an effort to
push her
cardiovascular system.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That's time. I'll leave you to tidy
up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, I realize that I forgot to give her
some
details concerning her upcoming
interview, so I
decide to drop by her
classroom.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I said it's completely meaningless to
even talk
about this "Takashi" character.
Leave me out of
it.
choice_data_list: （クラスでの様子も知っておきたい）

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"In five minutes, Takashi manages to
catch up
with his brother walking 5.6
kilometers ahead."
...It's ridiculous. They
just slapped a name on
there for the hell
of it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not here to talk about Takashi
himself. I want
to talk about turning his
feat into a reality.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you and I join forces, we just might be
able to
crack the formula for enabling a
human to run at
sixty-seven kilometers
an hour.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I might be able to use this in my race
research!
The possibilities have my heart
racing!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You agree, don't you, Cafe?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I don't know...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Don't hang me out to dr—oh.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Shakur, someone's here to see you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'll leave all that up to you. Go
ahead and
give the reporters some data
if you need to.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And by the way, I think this is the kind
of thing
you could have just messaged
me on LANE about.
choice_data_list: じゃあ、こっちで対応しておく

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I bet you really just wanted to see what
Shakur's
like off the track, huh?
choice_data_list: 近くを通りかかったから……

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I knew it. You're actually quite
interested in her,
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, why don't you introduce all
of your
friends, Shakur?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you already know, but I'm Agnes

Tachyon. And this here is Manhattan
Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon, who loves running
experiments,
and Manhattan Cafe, an
Umamusume with a
mysterious aura.
Both of them are runners with
bright
futures ahead of them.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We haven't debuted yet, but I'm sure
one of us
will probably be up against
Shakur at some point.
...Of course, I
can't say for sure.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Shakur spends every day surrounded by

wonderful friends like me and Cafe here,
laughing
and having a grand old time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right, you two?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's all you needed, right? You can
leave now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From what I could see, Air Shakur seems
right at
home in class. I feel like I caught
a tiny glimpse of
her ordinary side.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh sorry. You just looked so happy, it
was
infectious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion is studying abroad here as a

dignitary from Ireland. Her family
apparently
comes from the royal line of
another land. I
occasionally see her
together with Air Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It seems like there's something fun on
your mind.
Would you mind sharing?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I see. That Tachyon sure is a lot of
fun!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Although their fields of specialty are
different, it
always looks like Shakur is
enjoying herself when
she's having a
complicated discussion with
Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Well, if you say so then it must be right!
choice_data_list: 確かにそう見えた……かも

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I haven't learned anything more about
Shakur
since we first met. All she seems
to be hoping for
from our relationship is
that I might provide some

"unquantifiable influence."
choice_data_list: 今は、“トレーナーなだけ”なんだけどね

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Sure... but that's only for now.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to know what she said to
me the
first time I spoke to her? "Get
the hell away from
me!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
She looked me right in the eyes and said
she
wanted nothing to do with me. She
rejected me
outright with both her
attitude and her words.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It was so refreshing I couldn't help but
be happy.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
There's a certain elegance about
roundabout
expressions and the
consideration behind them.
However...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Shakur showed me her real self. Her
thoughts,
words, and body language
were all in complete
alignment.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'd like to be as honest as I
can as well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I never want to doubt myself or the
way I
ought to be.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I believe that if I do what I must, the two
of us will
see eye-to-eye one day.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
When I'm with Shakur, I feel it all the
more.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What is it I want to do? What is it I
ought to do?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Let's keep our little chat today a
secret from
Shakur, okay?
choice_data_list: ファインモーション、君は……
ファインモーション、貴方は……

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she'll just get angry at me for
filling your
head with nonsense.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Security Officer
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness. I think it's about time we
go.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Very well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's chat again sometime! Take care,
now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion's words echo in my mind. I
should
probably think more about the
things I ought to
be doing as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You were speaking to Fine, right? I
could see the
two of you looking awful
chummy from all the way
down the hall.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So, what nonsense did the little princess
fill your
head with?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Did I say somethin' funny? Spit it out,
right now!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Now I'm positive she's been talkin'
her usual
crap.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And as for you, do you really have time
to be
goofin' around?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We don't even have seven centimeters
of room to
spare. Maybe instead of
runnin' your mouth, how
about you start
runnin' your brain?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I already told you I'm willing to take any

advantage I can get, even if it's some

unquantifiable influence.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That goes for your ideas too. I expect practically nothing from you, but I'd still rather have almost nothing than nothing at all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So get thinking. Unless you like just
being here
for show, that is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur has never once called my
existence
unnecessary. That means that
there must still be a
role for me to play
as her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You don't have to get so excited.
